component.name: Diddy Kong Racing: Recompiled
component.summary: Native recompilation of Diddy Kong Racing

description.p: A native port powered by N64: Recompiled and RT64.
An unmodified, legally obtained Diddy Kong Racing USA (En,Fr) Rev 1 ROM is required and is not included.
First ROM-free binary alpha for macOS Apple silicon and Linux x86-64 / Steam Deck.
